intro: Lesson 46: Section A exam questions: 1.6 to 1.9. To understand how to answer Section A questions on justice, leadership, the battles and the final years

questions.q: Explain two lessons Muslims learn from the Battle of Uhud. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Obey the leader's orders: the archers left their post; patience after loss: the Muslims recovered and Allah's help came with obedience.
questions.model: Point 1: obedience. Develop: the archers left the hill against orders, which turned victory into loss. Point 2: patience and learning from mistakes. Develop: the Qur'an addressed the believers with lessons (3:152), not despair.

questions.q: Section A set 2 on the pupil PDF (our own questions): four 4-mark questions on 1.6 to 1.9 and one 12-mark: 'The Prophet's ﷺ greatest achievement was religious, not political.' Assess. Timed: 25 minutes.
questions.a: Mark-scheme style answers with set passages and a justified judgement
questions.model: Teacher answers the first 4-mark question aloud.

questions.q: Back to our ponder: leader in war or peace?
questions.a: Mostly peace; battles were few and for defence or broken treaties.
